title: GEMI: streamed answers carry no routing notes; embeddings answer within 30 s
goal: CEO direction 2026-11-12 ("Fix gemi completely"). A live sweep of the 9091 surface (isolated daemon, starter model, plug host) found two defects among others: (1) `stream: true` chat emitted `[SUSI ROUTING] local '...' selected ...` as assistant content; the GEMI server's stream callback now withholds routing notes, as the non-streamed reply always did. (2) `/v1/embeddings` gave no answer after 300 s: `GemiEngine::embed_text` tried every registered provider with a 60 s call each and no overall bound (on the CEO laptop it reached the machine's own Ollama and made it load a chat model). One request now has a 30 s budget across all providers (`EMBED_BUDGET`, `embed_from`), after which it answers 503 with the last provider's error.

results.live: Isolated daemon in a private network namespace (so it cannot reach the machine's real engines), plug host attached, starter model: streamed chat content 'Hello! It's a pleasure to meet you. How can I assist you today?' with no routing note (before: the note was appended as content); /v1/embeddings answers 503 at once when nothing can embed. Unit test: two providers that never answer -> error within the 300 ms test budget.

limitations: A provider call cut by the budget keeps its own thread until that call's own 60 s timeout ends; the request no longer waits for it.
Embeddings still try any registered provider, including chat-only local models; a 30 s budget bounds the cost, it does not choose an embedding model.
